    How much does it cost to play a round at TPC Sawgrass?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    A round at TPC Sawgrass's Stadium Course costs between approximately $550 (summer off-peak) and over $900 (peak season), varying by season due to dynamic pricing, with rates around $750-$775 in peak months (Sept-May) and lower in summer (June-Aug). Prices fluctuate, include a forecaddie and cart (path only), and can be found on the official TPC Sawgrass website.
     
    Pricing Breakdown (Players Stadium Course):
    • Peak Season (September - May): Starting around $750 - $775, but can reach $900 or more during busy times. 
    • Summer (June - August): Starting around $550, offering a significant discount due to heat. 
    • Dye's Valley Course: A less expensive alternative, with rates starting around $325-$350 in peak season. 
    What's Included: 
    • Practice balls, a cart (cart path only), and a forecaddie for the group.
    How to Book: 
    • Book directly through the official TPC Sawgrass website, typically up to 14 days in advance, though options to book further out may exist.
    Tips for Saving: 
    • Play in the summer for lower rates.
    • Look for "stay and play" packages at the Marriott resort.
    • Volunteer at The Players Championship for vouchers that offer deep discounts.
